(390008, 'multiple_choice', 'What do you write after research?', '["Recipe", "Paper", "Menu", "Letter"]', 'Paper', 5),

-- Lição 390009: Travel Adventures

(390009, 'multiple_choice', 'Where do you sleep when traveling?', '["Restaurant", "Hotel", "Airport", "Museum"]', 'Hotel', 5),

-- Lição 390010: Health and Fitness
